description: Initial configurable scoring rules for testing the PWB outcome model. Values are experimental, not production weights.
principles: Keep knowledge data separate from scoring rules.
Direct questionnaire signals should be stronger than supporting signals.
Demographic context modifies relevance rather than creating physiological need by itself.
Outcome priorities are calculated before foods and products are ranked.
Final recommendations remain subject to evidence, relationship strength and safety rules.

outcomePriority.note: Experimental weights only. They should be calibrated through test personas.

responseScoring.note: questions.json preserves the source questionnaire and T body-system associations. The complete numeric response-weighting specification still needs verification before production.

bodySystemNeed.source: Nine body-system scores from the existing questionnaire scoring model.
bodySystemNeed.normalisation: Use each system's authoritative maximum and thresholds.
bodySystemNeed.note: Continuous raw-score normalisation should be verified against the authoritative scoring specification.

menopause.note: Do not create a menopause score from age/gender alone.

antiBiasRules.evidenceFloor: Exclude or heavily penalise insufficient-evidence items.
antiBiasRules.broadCoverageDescription: Do not let foods/products win merely because they have many generic relationships.

evaluationCriteria: Sensible ranking changes when goals change

blockingItems: Verify authoritative numeric response scoring for all 48 questions.
Define numeric evidence and relationship-strength scales.
